_meta.note: arXiv 2610.08761 VeriFine (NVIDIA): judge-human alignment (Pearson/MAE) for rubric judges and Alpamayo-1.5 driving policies / Qwen3-VL-2B navigation policies across self-improvement rounds. Figure bar labels assigned by pdftotext -bbox order, confirmed against the rendered page colours.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B
models.description: NVIDIA Alpamayo 1.5 8B driving VLA/reasoning model; base policy in VeriFine (arXiv 2610.08761). Release date not given in the paper.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (Random curriculum, LingoJudge reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 1 baseline: Alpamayo 1.5 8B GRPO-RFT on randomly selected 25K examples with LingoJudge reward.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (LingoJudge curriculum + reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 1 baseline: LingoJudge used for both data selection and GRPO reward.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (Random curriculum, VeriFine-Judge-RB reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 1 baseline: random selection, reference-based VeriFine-Judge-RB reward.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (VeriFine-Judge-RB curriculum + reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 1 baseline: reference-based VeriFine-Judge-RB for selection and reward.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (Random curriculum, VeriFine-Judge-R1 reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 2 curriculum ablation: random selection with round-1 reference-free judge reward.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (Random curriculum, VeriFine-Judge-R2 reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 2 curriculum ablation: random selection with round-2 judge reward.

models.name: Alpamayo 1.5 8B RFT (Random curriculum, VeriFine-Judge-R3 reward)
models.description: VeriFine Tab 2 curriculum ablation: random selection with round-3 judge reward.

models.name: VeriFine Alpamayo 1.5 8B (Round 1)
models.description: VeriFine driving policy after self-improvement round 1: base Alpamayo 1.5 8B, GRPO-RFT with judge-guided curriculum and reward from VeriFine-Judge-R1 (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine Alpamayo 1.5 8B (Round 2)
models.description: VeriFine driving policy after self-improvement round 2: base Alpamayo 1.5 8B, GRPO-RFT with judge-guided curriculum and reward from VeriFine-Judge-R2 (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine Alpamayo 1.5 8B (Round 3)
models.description: VeriFine driving policy after self-improvement round 3: base Alpamayo 1.5 8B, GRPO-RFT with judge-guided curriculum and reward from VeriFine-Judge-R3 (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-R1 Teacher
models.description: VeriFine reference-free rubric teacher judge, round 1: Claude Opus 5 backbone with the round-1 coactively calibrated driving-reasoning rubric (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-R1 Student
models.description: VeriFine distilled student judge, round 1: Qwen3-VL 2B backbone pretrained on internal PAI-AV driving data, classifier head predicting rubric subscores (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-R2 Teacher
models.description: VeriFine reference-free rubric teacher judge, round 2: Claude Opus 5 backbone with the round-2 coactively calibrated driving-reasoning rubric (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-R2 Student
models.description: VeriFine distilled student judge, round 2: Qwen3-VL 2B backbone pretrained on internal PAI-AV driving data, classifier head predicting rubric subscores (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-R3 Teacher
models.description: VeriFine reference-free rubric teacher judge, round 3: Claude Opus 5 backbone with the round-3 coactively calibrated driving-reasoning rubric (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-R3 Student
models.description: VeriFine distilled student judge, round 3: Qwen3-VL 2B backbone pretrained on internal PAI-AV driving data, classifier head predicting rubric subscores (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine-Judge-RB
models.description: VeriFine reference-based rubric judge: DeBERTa-v3-base cross-encoder initialized from LingoJudge, trained on ~500K reference-candidate pairs; fixed anchor evaluator (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: LingoJudge
models.description: Lingo-Judge reference-based driving-reasoning evaluator from LingoQA (Marcu et al., 2024); used as baseline judge in VeriFine. Release date approximate (LingoQA arXiv Dec 2023).

models.name: Qwen3-VL 2B navigation base policy (VeriFine)
models.description: VeriFine robot-navigation base policy initialization from Qwen3-VL 2B (exact checkpoint/preprocessing not specified, so not mapped to the vendor Qwen3-VL-2B row).

models.name: VeriFine Qwen3-VL 2B Navigation (Round 1)
models.description: VeriFine robot-navigation policy after round 1: Qwen3-VL 2B SFT on judge-selected VLNVerse demonstrations (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine Qwen3-VL 2B Navigation (Round 2)
models.description: VeriFine robot-navigation policy after round 2 (exploration-efficiency curriculum): Qwen3-VL 2B SFT (arXiv 2610.08761).

models.name: VeriFine Navigation Judge R1
models.description: VeriFine reference-free robot-navigation rubric judge, round 1 (teacher/student not specified in Fig 4).

models.name: VeriFine Navigation Judge R2
models.description: VeriFine reference-free robot-navigation rubric judge, round 2 (teacher/student not specified in Fig 4).

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Reasoning Score (RB evaluator)
benchmarks.description: Policy reasoning score on internal NVIDIA driving-reasoning policy test set P_test (2,772 samples, multi-view video, free-form reasoning + trajectory), scored by the fixed reference-based VeriFine-Judge-RB. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Tab 1/2.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Reasoning Score (RF evaluator)
benchmarks.description: Policy reasoning score on internal NVIDIA driving-reasoning policy test set P_test (2,772 samples, multi-view video, free-form reasoning + trajectory), scored by the final reference-free VeriFine-Judge (R3). Source arXiv 2610.08761 Tab 1/2.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving minADE6 (lower better)
benchmarks.description: Minimum average displacement error over 6 trajectory samples on internal NVIDIA driving-reasoning policy test set P_test (2,772 samples, multi-view video, free-form reasoning + trajectory). Source arXiv 2610.08761 Tab 1/2.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving ADE (lower better)
benchmarks.description: Average displacement error of the predicted trajectory on internal NVIDIA driving-reasoning policy test set P_test (2,772 samples, multi-view video, free-form reasoning + trajectory). Source arXiv 2610.08761 Tab 1/2.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge-Human Pearson r
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set J_test (R1 514 + R2 218 scenarios): Pearson correlation of judge score with human annotation of policy reasoning (judge given final rubric where applicable). Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 3b/5b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge MAE (lower better)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set J_test: mean absolute error vs human scores, normalized 0-1. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 3b/5b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge Pearson r (R1 test subset)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set subset R1 (514 mostly nominal scenarios): judge-human Pearson r. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 6b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge MAE (R1 test subset, lower better)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set subset R1 (514): judge-human MAE, 0-1. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 6b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge Pearson r (R2 challenging subset)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set subset R2 (218 challenging policy-rollout scenarios): judge-human Pearson r. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 6d.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge MAE (R2 challenging subset, lower better)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set subset R2 (218): judge-human MAE, 0-1. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 6d.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge Pearson r (initial rubric, no co-calibration)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set: teacher judge with the pre-coactive-calibration rubric; Pearson r vs human. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 5b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge MAE (initial rubric, lower better)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set: teacher judge with the pre-calibration rubric; MAE 0-1. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 5b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge Pearson r (no rubric)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set: VLM judge prompted with a plain instruction and no detailed rubric; Pearson r vs human. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 5b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Judge MAE (no rubric, lower better)
benchmarks.description: VeriFine driving judge test set: VLM judge without rubric; MAE 0-1. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 5b.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Driving Test-Time Scaling Best-of-6 (human score)
benchmarks.description: 401 independent driving scenarios, 6 reasoning-action candidates from a fixed policy; judge selects one; metric is human-rated reasoning score of the selected candidate. Source arXiv 2610.08761 Sec 4.3/Fig 3c.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Robot Navigation Reasoning Score
benchmarks.description: Robot-navigation reasoning score on the VeriFine navigation policy test set built from VLNVerse egocentric trajectories (navigation rubric: safety-gated goal consistency + grounding/causation). Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 4.

benchmarks.name: VeriFine Robot Navigation Judge-Human Pearson r
benchmarks.description: Pearson correlation between the VeriFine navigation judge and human scores on the navigation judge test set (VLNVerse). Source arXiv 2610.08761 Fig 4.
